calls.title: Suren Raj and August Allard
calls.summary: Growth Book is undertaking an expansion of its support engineering team to include a senior support engineer in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region, addressing the lack of current coverage and enhancing its global customer service capabilities. This decision aligns with the company’s growth trajectory, driven by a rising customer base and sales figures. The current support team consists of two engineers operating during US and European hours, but adding an engineer in APAC will provide essential 24/7 support. The new hire will work closely with a Japan-based engineer to manage escalations and ensure efficient communication. Additionally, the onboarding process for new engineers is structured to address the complexity of the product, requiring two to six months of training, highlighting the critical need for skilled hires in a rapidly evolving tech landscape.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Support Engineering, A/B Testing, Escalation, Technical Support, Team Leadership
